other_conditions: The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
The applicant must have been selected by the Madhya Pradesh Government's Religious Trust and Endowment Department for the pilgrimage.
The applicant must have completed the Sindhu Darshan pilgrimage in Ladakh.
The applicant must not be an income taxpayer.
Financial assistance is available only once in the applicant's lifetime.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of 50% of pilgrimage expenses, up to ₹10,000 per pilgrim.
documents_required: Documents detailing actual expenses incurred during the journey
